Improvements
Agents in local workspaces can now search your chats for what was said in them.
Text you add to chat with ⌘L now keeps its formatting, so tables, code blocks, lists, and headings arrive as markdown instead of flattened text.
Agent messages written mid-turn now fold into the tool call group, with the latest message and tool call pinned while the agent works.
When one agent messages another chat, the message now reaches it during its current turn instead of waiting for the turn to end.
When a chat fails while using a custom Claude Code or Codex executable older than Conductor's bundled one, the error now says so and links to the setting.
You can now copy a queued message that failed to send, for example when workspace setup fails.
Fixes
Fixed app updates failing when an update server or download is unavailable.
Fixed a scroll jump when returning to a chat you had scrolled up in.
Fixed a question from Claude sometimes being hidden inside a collapsed group of tool calls.
Fixed a yellow outline appearing around charts and other graphics after clicking them.
Fixed the app icon appearing small on a gray tile in Finder, Activity Monitor, and other macOS 26 icon previews.
Misc
The Open in menu for local workspaces moved to the bottom of the workspace info card, and the rename pencil was removed from the card header.
Removed the floating Next unread button above the composer. Its keyboard shortcut and command palette entry still work.
Added a "Send usage data and crash reports" setting in Settings → Account.
